main_body: patient bed (mattress with pillow and sheet inside metal frame)
top_band: headboard top rim at rows 11-12 (light grey), then headboard front face at rows 13-21, then main mattress top surface (white/light grey pillow and sheet with blue stripe) from rows 22 to 42
evidence: The bed shows both horizontal top surfaces and vertical south faces: the headboard at the north has a 2-row top (rows 11-12) and vertical slatted face (rows 13-21), followed by the main horizontal mattress top surface with pillow and folded sheet (rows 22-42), a front edge/foot rail at row 43-44, and a recessed shadowed lower front apron/base at rows 45-47.

style.evidence: The bed uses a 6-step cool grey/slate ramp for the metal frame and a 4-5 step white/lavender-grey ramp plus a 4-step blue ramp for the bedding. Shading on the pillow, sheet folds, and metal posts is well-structured, though the smooth hospital bedding naturally has less micro-speckle than the rustic stall and stone well references.
